definitions.explanation: The period of life roughly between 40 and 60, or a person in that age range. Can be used as a noun or as a modifier.

examples.japanese: {中年|ちゅうねん}の{男性|だんせい}が{話|はな}しかけてきた。
examples.english: A middle-aged man spoke to me.

examples.japanese: {中年|ちゅうねん}になると{体力|たいりょく}の{衰|おとろ}えを{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: When you reach middle age, you start to feel a decline in stamina.

examples.japanese: {中年|ちゅうねん}{太|ぶと}りを{気|き}にして、ジョギングを{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: Worried about middle-age weight gain, I started jogging.

notes:
{中年|ちゅうねん} refers to the middle years of adulthood, typically around 40 to 60.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中年|ちゅうねん}{男性|だんせい}/{女性|じょせい} (middle-aged man/woman)
- {中年|ちゅうねん}{太|ぶと}り (middle-age weight gain)
- {中年|ちゅうねん}の{危機|きき} (midlife crisis)
- {中年|ちゅうねん}{以降|いこう} (from middle age onward)

AGE STAGES:
- {青年|せいねん} (young adult, roughly 15-30)
- {中年|ちゅうねん} (middle-aged, roughly 40-60)
- {老年|ろうねん}/{高齢者|こうれいしゃ} (elderly, roughly 65+)
